description: Complete workflow for integrating a new logistics provider or shipping method into operations systems

tasks.title: Evaluate logistics provider requirements
tasks.description: Review provider's API documentation, integration requirements, and service levels

tasks.title: Negotiate rates and service agreement
tasks.description: Finalize pricing structure, service levels, zones covered, and contractual terms

tasks.title: Set up provider account and credentials
tasks.description: Create account, obtain API keys, configure authentication in ERPNext

tasks.title: Configure shipping rules in ERPNext
tasks.description: Set up shipping rules for zones, weights, and service types. Map to provider services

tasks.title: Develop API integration
tasks.description: Build integration for rate calculation, label generation, and tracking updates

tasks.title: Test integration in sandbox environment
tasks.description: Test rate calculations, label printing, tracking updates, and error handling

tasks.title: Train warehouse staff on new provider
tasks.description: Train team on label printing, packing requirements, pickup procedures, and troubleshooting

tasks.title: Set up monitoring and alerts
tasks.description: Configure alerts for failed shipments, tracking delays, and API errors

tasks.title: Pilot launch with limited orders
tasks.description: Process first 10-20 shipments, monitor for issues, gather feedback from warehouse team

tasks.title: Address pilot issues and refine
tasks.description: Fix any bugs, adjust workflows, update documentation based on pilot feedback

tasks.title: Full production rollout
tasks.description: Enable provider for all applicable shipments, monitor performance closely

description: Complete physical inventory count, reconciliation, and variance analysis process

tasks.title: Schedule audit and prepare plan
tasks.description: Set audit date, assign count teams, define zones, prepare count sheets and equipment

tasks.title: Freeze inventory transactions
tasks.description: Stop all receiving, picking, and transfers during count period. Notify all stakeholders

tasks.title: Generate system inventory snapshot
tasks.description: Export current inventory balances from ERPNext as baseline for comparison

tasks.title: Conduct physical count - Zone A
tasks.description: First count team performs physical count of Zone A items, record on count sheets

tasks.title: Conduct physical count - Zone B
tasks.description: Second count team performs physical count of Zone B items, record on count sheets

tasks.title: Conduct physical count - Zone C
tasks.description: Third count team performs physical count of Zone C items, record on count sheets

tasks.title: Enter count data into system
tasks.description: Input all physical count quantities into ERPNext inventory audit module

tasks.title: Generate variance report
tasks.description: Compare physical counts to system balances, identify discrepancies by item and location

tasks.title: Investigate significant variances
tasks.description: Research high-value discrepancies, check recent transactions, look for data entry errors

tasks.title: Conduct recount for disputed items
tasks.description: Physical recount of items with significant variances to confirm accuracy

tasks.title: Approve and post adjustments
tasks.description: Management approval of variances, post stock adjustments to correct system balances

tasks.title: Resume normal operations
tasks.description: Unfreeze inventory transactions, notify all teams that audit is complete

tasks.title: Analyze root causes of variances
tasks.description: Identify patterns in discrepancies, determine if process improvements are needed

tasks.title: Prepare audit report for management
tasks.description: Compile final report with variance analysis, financial impact, and recommendations

description: Complete workflow for vetting, approving, and integrating a new supplier into operations

tasks.title: Initial supplier evaluation
tasks.description: Review supplier capabilities, product range, certifications, and references

tasks.title: Request and review supplier documentation
tasks.description: Collect business licenses, insurance certificates, quality certifications, financial statements

tasks.title: Conduct supplier site visit or virtual audit
tasks.description: Visit facility to assess quality controls, production capacity, and working conditions

tasks.title: Request product samples for testing
tasks.description: Order samples of key products for quality evaluation and compatibility testing

tasks.title: Evaluate samples and provide feedback
tasks.description: Test samples for quality, specifications, packaging. Document any issues or concerns

tasks.title: Negotiate pricing and payment terms
tasks.description: Discuss volume discounts, payment terms, minimum orders, delivery schedules

tasks.title: Draft and review supplier agreement
tasks.description: Prepare contract covering terms, quality standards, delivery requirements, warranties

tasks.title: Obtain legal and management approval
tasks.description: Route agreement through legal review and get final sign-off from management

tasks.title: Execute supplier agreement
tasks.description: Sign contract with supplier, obtain countersignature, distribute copies to stakeholders

tasks.title: Create supplier record in ERPNext
tasks.description: Set up supplier master with contact info, payment terms, shipping addresses, tax details

tasks.title: Configure items and pricing in system
tasks.description: Add supplier's products to item master, input negotiated prices, set reorder levels

tasks.title: Place trial purchase order
tasks.description: Create first PO for limited quantity to test ordering and receiving process

tasks.title: Receive and inspect trial order
tasks.description: Verify order accuracy, inspect quality, test receiving workflow, document any issues

tasks.title: Approve supplier for regular ordering
tasks.description: Final approval to add supplier to approved vendor list for ongoing purchasing
